import re
import sys

variables = "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p TMP".split()
values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in variables) + ";")
